Step 3. The convex functional \(\Phi_{01310013}\) on the Kahler manifold satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01310013}\| \leq C_01310013\) by the convex embedding theorem.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the polynomial convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01310011 \cdot C_01310012 \cdot C_01310013\).
